name: What is the difference between renovating a mobile home and a stick-built home?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between renovating a mobile home and a stick-built home?

acceptedAnswer.text: While many renovation principles apply to both, mobile homes and stick-built homes have distinct differences. Mobile homes are typically built to HUD code standards, while stick-built homes adhere to local or state building codes. This can impact structural elements, material choices, and load-bearing capacities. Mobile homes often have different framing and foundation systems, requiring specialized knowledge for major alterations. Permitting and financing also tend to differ between the two housing types.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mobile homes follow HUD codes, while stick-built homes follow local building codes, affecting structural elements, materials, foundations, and often requiring specialized renovation approaches and different permitting.
